environment.description: Same ECS Fargate service in private subnet behind ALB. The ALB target group has a stickiness policy with 1-day duration. An AWS WAFv2 WebACL is associated with the ALB containing a custom rule group 'internal-response-transform' with a rule action override that inserts response headers via a CloudFront function (the ALB actually fronted by CloudFront distribution with OAC). The CloudFront function cf-security-headers-v3 appends headers including 'content-security-policy: default-src \'self\'; script-src \'self\' https://cdn.internal.corp; object-src \'none\'; base-uri \'self\'' on all responses with content-type text/html. The function also sets X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Note: the CSP does NOT include 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval' in script-src. SQS queue has the same cross-service access. CloudFront cache behavior has TTL 0 for /dashboard path pattern to ensure fresh responses.
